plugin.note: Hydras have 0 ranged defence but +160 melee and magic defence, so ranged is the effective style; they are draconic, so dragonbane weapons apply, and they carry a 40% earth elemental weakness. The task page names no specific weapon list - the dragonbane set here is the wiki-verified draconic credit, not a task-page tier list.

requirements: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Bigger and Badder (50 points) for Colossal Hydra superior spawns
An active Konar hydra task to fight the Alchemical Hydra boss
mechanics: Hydras attack with ranged and magic at 6-tick speed, starting on a random style and switching after three attacks regardless of hits.
After roughly 30 seconds a hydra spits poison at three random tiles (one under the player) in a 3x3 splash, dealing 4 poison damage every two ticks; poison immunity reduces this to 1-2.
Hydras have +160 stab/slash/crush/magic defence bonuses and 0 ranged defence.
Hydras have a 40% weakness to earth spells.

methods.label: Ranged with prayer switching
methods.summary: Range the 17 task-only hydras, praying against the style you have the lowest defence towards and switching when the hydra switches after three attacks.
requiredOrKeyItems: Boots of stone, brimstone, or granite
prayers: Protect from Magic if wearing melee armour
Protect from Missiles if wearing ranged armour
steps: Activate the protection prayer for the attack style you have the lowest defence towards, typically magic in melee armour or ranged in ranged armour.
Switch to the other protection prayer when the hydra starts attacking with the other style; it switches only after three consecutive attacks of the same type.
Attack with ranged because hydras have 0 ranged defence and +160 against everything else.
Set up a dwarf multicannon if desired - the hydra area is cannonable despite being single-combat.
Move off the poison tiles when the hydra spits at three random tiles roughly every 30 seconds.
risks: The area is not safespottable and hydras are aggressive.
Without boots of stone/brimstone/granite (or the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary) the dungeon floor deals rapid damage.

methods.label: Poison handling
methods.summary: Mitigate the periodic three-tile poison spit.
requiredOrKeyItems: Antipoison, anti-venom, or a serpentine helm
steps: Expect a poison spit at three random tiles (one at your location) roughly every 30 seconds; the initial splash covers 3x3.
Step away from the splattered tiles to avoid the 4-damage-per-two-ticks poison pools.
Bring poison immunity to reduce the tile damage to 1-2.

methods.label: Alchemical Hydra alternative
methods.summary: Kill the Alchemical Hydra boss instead of regular hydras for profit and collection log progress.
steps: Take the task to the Alchemical Hydra on the lower level of Karuulm Slayer Dungeon, past the Tasakaal.
The boss can only be killed while on a hydra Slayer task and offers very lucrative common drops.
Follow the boss strategy: lure it over the matching coloured vent each phase to remove its 75% damage reduction.

methods.label: Colossal Hydra superior
methods.summary: Handle Colossal Hydra spawns after Bigger and Badder.
steps: Expect a Colossal Hydra roughly 1/200 kills (1/150 after elite Combat Achievements).
It has no elemental weakness and higher defences than regular hydras but keeps the family's low ranged defence relative to melee and magic.
It carries the highest imbued heart drop rate at 1/160.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Ranged attacks exploit hydras' 0 ranged defence; the dragon hunter crossbow adds the dragonbane credit against their draconic attribute.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter lance melee is viable against the draconic attribute despite the +160 melee defence bonuses.

styleOptions.label: Earth magic
styleOptions.summary: Earth spells exploit the 40% elemental weakness; the dragon hunter wand adds dragonbane magic.
